newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Harradine concerned about Telstra.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Harradine concerned about Telstra.

text.p: Australian Independent senator Brian Harradine said on Monday he had a number of concerns about the partial sale of government-owned telecommunications giant Telstra Corp, although he did not say how he would vote.

"Areas of great concern to me are whether the state-of-the-art communications technology can be guaranteed in regional Australia ... and whether Tasmania's natural heritage would be recognised from the disbursement of funds from the Natural Heritage Trust," Harradine told parliament.
Harradine and fellow Independent senator Mal Colston hold the key to the passing of the Telstra privatisation bill.
The Australian government plans to raise A$8 billion through the sale of one-third of Telstra, with A$1 billion of the proceeds earmarked to establish an environmental protection package.

A Senate Committee report earlier on Monday recommended against the Telstra sale, saying there was no evidence to back the government's claim that the economy and consumers would benefit from the sale.
